status: Ordered on-screen static and shared-clock snapshot pipelines implemented in development; explicit residual gates remain

public_contract.compatibility: Existing CompositeEffect/+ and U+001F index addresses preserved. ShaderFactory/ShaderSession signatures and sealed errors unchanged. Additive controlledShaderEffect CompositeEffect overload plus optional ShaderPipelineProvider/Session extension.
public_contract.queries: ANIMATED_SESSION for a composite means createPipelineSession, not old createAnimatedSession. Non-provider factories retain UNKNOWN and pipeline extension returns UnsupportedEffect without rendering. Structural queries do not read source/uniform/provider state or allocate native resources.
public_contract.order: Left to right; nested and identity preserve order; required child fails whole chain.
public_contract.clock: Every AnimatedShaderEffect gets same caller timestamp, ignoring child time/isAnimating. Paused unchanged controlled scene settles; explicit inputRevision refreshes live inputs. Static sample chains use shaderEffect and schedule no clock. Explicit built-in playback metadata suppresses only known playback fields; custom GPU animate Booleans remain editable.
public_contract.snapshots: Resolve runtime sources/uniforms before native creation; copy numeric arrays; image handles borrowed. Source/value/size/live replacement commits whole successful filter. Retain previous filter on failure. Source String capture explicitly precedes each child uniform provider; original source getter is never delegated at backend creation. Composite Compose nonpositive target dimensions clear filter until positive; manual invalid-size refresh fails and retains previous snapshot.
public_contract.ownership: Skia native composition/builders retain native references, temporary child wrappers close after retention. Session close drops its retained filter; returned Compose wrappers keep their native reference. No deterministic final native disposal/memory stabilization claim.
public_contract.cost: Each refresh allocates filter state. Skia compiled programs use LRU. Android non-color snapshots use source cache; structural color snapshots including static legacy children use fresh RuntimeShader and may compile each refresh.
public_contract.stable_keys: Sample-only explicit child keys1..64 alnum/_/-; pipeline1..16 children. Separate bounded ShaderLab-Pipeline1 text format (262144 bytes); per-child scalar preset/schema version; unknown/malformed/duplicate input rejects whole replacement. Scalar preset1/workbench draft formats unchanged.
public_contract.export: Actual generated Kotlin includes keys/order/backend requirements and shared clock; compiled externally on JVM/Android/Wasm/iOS simulator. Live/image pipeline generator inputs explicitly rejected. ImageProcessor composites remain unsupported, including single-child.
